consent.title: Consent to use your biometric data
consent.biometric: To confirm your identity, we compare a selfie with the photo on your ID document. This comparison uses biometric data: measurements of your facial features. Your biometric data is used only to verify your identity for this request.
consent.processing: We process the photos of your ID document and your selfie only for this verification. They are deleted when the organization that asked for this verification no longer needs them, in line with its retention policy. You can stop at any time by closing this page.
consent.biometric-matching: Optional: we also compare your selfie and its background with earlier selfies submitted to this organization, to stop one person from using several identities. A template of your face is kept for {{days}} days. You can still verify if you leave this unticked.
consent.device-recognition: Optional: recognise this device on later visits, to protect my account from misuse.
consent.automated-decision: Optional: I agree that automated decisions can be made about this verification from my biometric data, without a person reviewing them first. You can ask for a person to review a decision.
consent.checkbox: I agree to the collection and use of my biometric data as described above.
consent.unavailable: This verification asks you to agree to a text that this version cannot show. Contact the organization that asked you to verify.

notice.session-integrity: To protect your verification against fraud, this page checks how it is being used, such as whether a browser is automated. It does not read your keystrokes or what you type.
notice.device-recognition: This service recognises the device you use, to protect accounts from misuse.
notice.play-integrity: To protect your verification against fraud, the app you are using asks Google Play to confirm that it is the genuine app on a device that has not been tampered with. For this, Google receives the app's package name, version and signing certificate, its licence status and an attestation of this device's integrity.

consent.processing: We process the photos of your ID document and your selfie only for this verification. They are deleted when the organization that asked for this verification no longer needs them, in line with its retention policy. You can stop at any time by closing this screen.

notice.session-integrity: To protect your verification against fraud, this app checks how it is being used: whether a debugger is attached, and signs of an emulator, a rooted device or a tampering tool. For this it reads the device's build properties, the app's own process (its memory map, thread names and loaded classes), the mount table and whether known files are present, and sends only the names of the signs it finds. It does not read what you type or which other apps you have.

consent.title: Share your verified details with {{recipient}}
consent.source:
{{source}} asks for your agreement to share the details it verified about you with {{recipient}}, so that {{recipient}} can reuse this verification instead of asking you to verify again.

What is shared: {{categories}}. Nothing is shared unless you agree, and choosing not to share does not stop your verification.

Your agreement covers one share with {{recipient}} for this purpose only. It ends after {{expires}} if the details have not been shared by then.

To withdraw your agreement, {{withdraw}}. Withdrawing stops any share that has not happened yet. Details already shared are kept by {{recipient}} under its own privacy notice.
consent.destination:
{{recipient}} asks for your agreement to receive the details {{source}} verified about you, so that you do not have to verify again.

What {{recipient}} receives: {{categories}}. {{recipient}} uses them only to verify your identity for this request and keeps them for {{retention}}. Nothing is received unless you agree, and choosing not to share does not stop your verification: you verify here instead.

Your agreement ends after {{expires}} if the details have not been received by then.

To withdraw your agreement, {{withdraw}}. Withdrawing stops any transfer that has not happened yet.
consent.biometric-source: I agree that {{source}} shares my biometric data with {{recipient}}: the photo of my face on my ID document, my selfie and the results of comparing them.
consent.biometric-destination: I agree that {{recipient}} receives my biometric data from {{source}}: the photo of my face on my ID document, my selfie and the results of comparing them. {{recipient}} keeps it for {{retention}}, only to verify my identity.
consent.withdraw: Withdraw my agreement to share with {{recipient}}

link.title: We could not open your verification
link.missing: Open this page from the verification link you received. The link is missing or incomplete.
link.invalid: This verification link is not valid. Check that you opened the whole link, or ask for a new one.
link.mismatch: This link belongs to a different verification. Open the latest link you received.
link.used: This link has already been used or has expired. Each link works only once. Ask the organization that sent it for a new one.
link.reloaded: This page was opened from a one-time link, which works only once, so it cannot be reloaded. Open the link you received again, or ask for a new one if it no longer works.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.network: We could not reach the verification service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The verification service took too long to answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: This verification link is no longer valid. Ask the organization that sent it for a new one.
errors.conflict: Your verification changed, perhaps in another window. Try again to continue.
errors.tooLarge: This photo is larger than 10 MB. Retake it or choose a smaller photo.
errors.unsupportedImage: We could not use this photo. Retake it or choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.notAccepted: This was not accepted. Check what you entered and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.server: The verification service is having trouble. Try again in a few minutes.
